name: exit
description: _exit() terminates the calling process immediately, closing all open file descriptors and making its children orphans inherited by init. The exit status is returned to the parent process via wait calls. _Exit() is equivalent to _exit().

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: The exit status of the process, with the low-order 8 bits returned to the parent

bugs: The _exit() function may cause delays due to pending I/O on closed file descriptors, and its behavior regarding thread termination has changed in glibc versions since 2.3, now invoking exit_group(2) to terminate all threads.
